title: fix(fields, plugin-form): permission-ref refuses a blocked option itself, knows the grant by object, drops a seeded package, keys holders by pair, labels cells by holder
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-sales"} -->
_Requested by **Sales** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4Uu?thread=cmsg_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4UuECYFhXgWn9fcRFWR3rU6zj)_

Fixes #32795

## 维护者速读

- 问题：#32793 之后，权限集下拉框在两个包同名时还剩 5 处按名字走的边角（禁用项只靠下拉框拦、只认字段名不认对象、新建表单带种子包时界面和载荷不一致、选项键 `名@包`、列表单元格按名字取标签）。
- 改法：组件自己的提交函数拒绝禁用项；记录表单把所编辑的对象盖到 `permission-ref` 字段上（新导出 `withFormObject`），组件按「对象 + 字段」认授权；授权对象的新建表单不再带入包列的种子；选项键改成 `[名, 包]` 的 JSON；单元格在行里带包列时按（包，名）取标签。
- 第 3 项按裁定选「不把种子当选择显示」：`createHolderPackagePayload` 一字未改，条件照旧，有 pin 钉住。
- 单持有者（CONTROL）：选项、写入值、载荷、标签都与 `main` 相同。没有放宽任何服务端或权限判定；没盖章的字段、其它对象都更窄（包选项禁用）。
- 契约：只加 `@object-ui/fields` 的 `withFormObject`、`FORM_OBJECT_KEY` 两个导出（Clause-② widening），不加 i18n 键，不改服务端。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。
- 席位意见：席位（domain:ui#6）审过。专题席红线复读 PASS-with-nits（6836597761）：授权新建表单只丢掉包列的种子值、不放行任何值，写入逻辑一字未改；组件自己拒绝被禁用的选项；只有盖了表单对象章的字段才认作授权字段，比原来更窄。契约复核默认档 PASS（6836081574，fields 新增两个导出）。复读的 nit 转跟进卡。CI 全绿，按队列落地。

Clause-②: yes (widening)
Metadata-protocol: none

## Items (re-read on `main` at `8ce5827f`: all five still held, none struck)

| # | Item | Result | Pin (each ablated: revert the fix only → red; restore → blob equals HEAD) |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | `commit()` relied on the combobox honouring `disabled` | **fixed**: `commit` returns early for every option it marks blocked (`blockedKeys`) | `RegistryRefField.blockedOptionGuard-32795.test.tsx` swaps the combobox for one that ignores `disabled`: a blocked click writes no name and no package; the environment's option still writes the name |
| 2 | `holderPackageFieldOf` matched the field name only | **fixed**: `holderPackageFieldOf(object, field)`. The object comes from a stamp the record form puts on a `permission-ref` field definition (`withFormObject`, on both field builders: `ObjectForm`'s generated fields and `sectionFields`, which the tabbed and wizard arms read). A field with no stamp, or another object's, is read as a bare-name target. | fields `permissionRefEdges-32795` (item 2); plugin-form `objectFormPermissionRefEdges-32795` (generated fields, and `sectionFields` for ObjectForm sections, TabbedForm and WizardForm, grant vs `crm_deal`) |
| 3 | A create form seeded with the package showed that holder while the payload sent the name alone | **fixed (option: do not show the seed as a pick)**: `withoutSeededHolderPackage` drops `permission_set_package` from a grant's CREATE opening values, from both seed builders (`ObjectForm` `formOpeningValues` for the values and the baseline, and `seedCreateValues` for the modal, drawer, tabbed and wizard arms). Edit forms, other objects and other keys are untouched. `createHolderPackagePayload` is unchanged. | plugin-form `objectFormPermissionRefEdges-32795` (item 3: the seeded form shows the environment's set and saves the name alone; a later pick of the package is saved; the helper's own cases; `seedCreateValues`; the payload helper's seed-equal and no-baseline cases still unsent) |
| 4 | Option key `name@package` did not reserve `@` | **fixed**: a package holder's key is `JSON.stringify([name, package])`; the environment's and one holder's key stays the name | fields `permissionRefEdges-32795` (item 4): a stored value `sales_user@com.acme.crm` stays its own "not found" option, and the CRM holder's option still picks CRM |
| 5 | `RegistryRefCell` labelled by name only | **fixed**: the catalog also keeps labels by `(holder, name)`; where the row carries `permission_set_package` and the field is `permission_set`, the cell draws the label of the holder the server reads the row as (`storedGrantHolders`), and the bare name when that is no single holder | fields `permissionRefEdges-32795` (item 5, including a CONTROL case: no row, a row without the column, another column, one holder → by name as before) |

### Item 5's call sites

None changed. Every list and detail call site already hands the cell its row as `dependentValues` (`plugin-grid` `objectGridGenerateColumns.tsx` and `ObjectGrid.tsx`, `plugin-detail` `DetailSection.tsx` and `HeaderHighlight.tsx`). So the change stays inside `ui/packages/fields/**`. A list that does not read the package column gives a row without it, and that cell labels by name as before.

### Item 3: why not keep the seed on the wire

Keeping a seeded package would need `createHolderPackagePayload` to send a value the user did not change against the seed. That widens the one place a `readonly` column is lifted. Not showing the seed keeps that helper exactly as narrow as before, and the screen then reads the name the way the server will stamp it.

## Files

- `ui/packages/fields/src/widgets/RegistryRefField.tsx`: blocked-option guard, pair keys, object-aware pairing.
- `ui/packages/fields/src/widgets/permissionSetHolders.ts`: `FORM_OBJECT_KEY`, `withFormObject`, `readFormObject`, `holderPackageFieldOf(object, field)`, `rowHolderPackageFieldOf`.
- `ui/packages/fields/src/widgets/registryCatalog.ts`: settled catalog also keeps `holders` (labels by `(holder, name)`).
- `ui/packages/fields/src/widgets/RegistryRefCell.tsx`: labels by holder where the row names one.
- `ui/packages/fields/src/index.tsx`: exports `withFormObject`, `FORM_OBJECT_KEY`.
- `ui/packages/plugin-form/src/{ObjectForm.tsx,sectionFields.ts}`: stamp the object; `ObjectForm.tsx` and `schemaDefaults.ts` drop the seeded package on a grant create.
- `ui/packages/plugin-form/src/sanitize.ts`: `withoutSeededHolderPackage` (module-internal, not exported from the package).
- Tests: two new fields files, one new plugin-form file, and `RegistryRefField.packageHolders-32770.test.tsx`'s grant field now carries the stamp the form puts on it.

## Tests

- `pnpm exec vitest run packages/fields/ packages/plugin-form/` (from `ui/`): 536 files passed, 1 skipped; 7130 tests passed, 8 skipped.
- `pnpm exec vitest run packages/core/src/utils/__tests__/column-identity.ratchet.test.ts`: 7/7.
- `tsc` type-check of `@object-ui/fields` and `@object-ui/plugin-form` (both `tsc --noEmit` and `tsconfig.test.json`): exit 0.
- `node scripts/check-sdui-manifest.mjs`: exit 0. eslint `--no-inline-config` on the changed files: 0 errors.
- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands` on the committed head: 37 derived families, all exit 0; `--ran`: 37 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN.
- Ablations (8, one per fix): each pin goes red with its fix reverted, and the file's blob equals HEAD after restore. The item-5 CONTROL case stays green under its ablation.

## Acceptance notes

- No server change. Nothing relaxes a security or permission verdict: the server still judges every insert and re-stamps the package on update. Every change in the widget makes it narrower (a blocked click, an unstamped field, another object), and the payload helper is byte-identical.
- Item 5 recognises the grant pairing in the READ cell by the field name `permission_set` and the row carrying a `permission_set_package` key, because a cell is handed a field and a row, never the object. It is display only and decides no write.
- The object stamp is put only on a field definition that declares `widget: 'permission-ref'`. Every other field definition is handed on as the same object.
- The seed is dropped by the object's `name` in `seedCreateValues` (the definition the arms pass), and by `schema.objectName` in `ObjectForm`.
- Residual, not filed: a stored value literally spelled as a JSON pair (`["name","pkg"]`) would share a key with that holder's option. No permission-set name can be spelled that way (the name grammar is snake_case).
